summary: Multiplies a 4-component vector at a2 by a 4x4 matrix at a3 and stores the resulting 4-vector at a1. Matrix pointer alignment (a3 & 0xF) selects between unaligned 8-byte half-row loads and aligned __m128 row loads; both branches compute x*row0 + y*row1 + z*row2 + w*row3. Returns a1, the destination vector.

operations.description: Dispatch on matrix pointer alignment: when (a3 & 0xF) != 0 the matrix rows are loaded as 8-byte halves, otherwise rows are read as aligned 16-byte __m128 values at offsets 0, 16, 32, 48.
Broadcast each of the four source components from *a2 (shuffle immediates 0, 85, 170, 255 select x, y, z, w) and multiply each broadcast by the corresponding 16-byte matrix row.
Sum the four row contributions to form the transformed vector: *a1 = x*row0 + y*row1 + z*row2 + w*row3.
Store the full 16-byte result 4-vector into *a1 at offset 0.
Return a1, the destination vector pointer.
Legacy ABI name 'SSE_4x4_Matrix_4_Vector_Multiply' is retained as the identity signal for this entry; it does not claim an owner object.
